title: Everyday Phrases — A Conference Call
scene_zh: 電話會議 · 情境對話
title_quote: We need a call with Berlin.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💼 實用電話會議必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Conference Call
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用電話會議情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從發日曆邀請、確認跨時區時間、測試設備，到上線等人、靜音降噪、共享螢幕、逐項過進度、定責任人與截止日、會後跟進行動項與約下次會議，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多職場場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Conference Call phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering calendar invites, time zones, tech checks, muting, screen sharing, progress reviews, owners and deadlines, follow-ups and next steps. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more workplace scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a call with Berlin.
dialogue.zh: 我們得和柏林那邊開個會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's set it up this week.
dialogue.zh: 我們這週就把時間定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll send out a calendar invite.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add everyone from the product team.
dialogue.zh: 把產品團隊的人都加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我要把與會名單列出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep it under ten people.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who else has to join us?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anna from legal, and our lead.
dialogue.zh: 法務的安娜，還有我們的主管。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the meeting app we always use.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə ˈmitɪŋ æp wi ˈɔlˌweɪz juz/
dialogue.zh: 就用我們慣用的那個會議軟體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll paste the link inside it.
dialogue.zh: 我會把連結貼在邀請裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then no one hunts for it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðɛn noʊ wʌn hʌnts fər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，這樣就沒有人要找來找去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some people can't open that app.
dialogue.zh: 有些人用不了那個軟體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then add a backup dial-in number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æd ə ˈbækˌʌp ˈdaɪl ɪn ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 那再加一組備用電話撥入號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個連結之後會失效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it stays live all month.
dialogue.zh: 不會，這個連結整個月都有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是排程上最大的麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three for us, nine their evening.
dialogue.zh: 我們三點，他們晚上九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine is too late for them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then try two in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two works, and they said yes.
dialogue.zh: 兩點可以，他們也答應了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write both times in it.
dialogue.zh: 我會把兩個時間都寫進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 馬可週二早上要搭飛機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we meet on Wednesday instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，週三就不會撞到航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我來起草一份簡短議程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 只列三個主題，不要更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it tight, people are busy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's a full but fair list.
dialogue.zh: 這份清單滿檔但還算合理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我會寫三行說明的目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每項都要有一個明確結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Berlin leads with their beta update.
dialogue.zh: 柏林先用他們的測試版進度開場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does each speaker get?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我會預留一些緩衝時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的昨天還能用，希望沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp is behind me now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the desk lamp on instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better? Can you see my face?
dialogue.zh: 好點了嗎？你看得到我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now you look nice and clear.
dialogue.zh: 現在你看起來清楚多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我再試一下喇叭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The echo was awful last time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把多餘的瀏覽器分頁關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They slow the whole screen share.
dialogue.zh: 它們會讓整個畫面共享變慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asked me to restart twice.
dialogue.zh: 它已經叫我重啟兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 重啟能解決大部分的小毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned that one the hard way.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lɜrnd ðæt wʌn ðə hɑrd weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這點我可是學得很辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll grab one from the drawer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's do a quick dry run.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we can test screen sharing.
dialogue.zh: 這樣我們可以測試畫面共享。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me, I always lose it.
dialogue.zh: 示範給我看，我每次都找不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click share, then pick the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, that's the tricky part.
dialogue.zh: 我會了，那就是關鍵步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they see my whole desktop?
dialogue.zh: 他們看得到我整個桌面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 看得到，現在全都顯示出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的簡報看起來超小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zoom it to fit the page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好多了，謝謝你一起檢查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 必須所有人都同意才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll ask at the start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, let's keep it by the book.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, lɛts kip ɪt baɪ ðə bʊk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some countries are strict about it.
dialogue.zh: 有些國家對這事很嚴格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, half join from noisy trains.
dialogue.zh: 要，一半的人會在吵的地方上線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll set them on by default.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這對母語非英文的同事有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The invite is ready to send.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it, I'll check the times.
dialogue.zh: 發吧，我再核對一次時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有的，克勞斯一早就接受了邀請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we hope the tech holds.
dialogue.zh: 現在只希望設備不要出包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, I'm in the waiting room.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu, aɪm ɪn ðə ˈweɪtɪŋ rum/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The host hasn't opened the room.
dialogue.zh: 主持人還沒開放會議室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give her a minute, she's last.
dialogue.zh: 給她一分鐘，她是最後一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is anyone else on this call?
dialogue.zh: 這通會議還有別人在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only Anna and I so far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 嗨安娜，你看起來很精神。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coffee helped, I had two cups.
dialogue.zh: 幸虧有咖啡，我喝了兩杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 柏林團隊，你們能上線嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trying now, the app is loading.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 柏林那邊上線了，還差馬可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marco just walked into the room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone's mic is full of static.
dialogue.zh: 有人的麥克風全是雜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我覺得那是馬可的線路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 馬可，我們聽到劈啪雜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我剛才沒聽清你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我是馬可，新來的工程師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 馬可，說句話讓我們聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is this better? Can you hear?
dialogue.zh: 這樣好些了嗎？你們聽得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好多了，就保持這個音量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you say that once more?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slow down, my notes can't keep.
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，我筆記跟不上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But her slides are easy to read.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt hɜr slaɪdz ɑr ˈizi tu rid/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 馬可整段都含含糊糊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him to use a headset.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有一隻狗在很大聲地叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不是我家的狗，有人忘了靜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 安娜，你的麥克風開著，大家聽得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 靜音吧，沒聽到什麼重要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒輪到你發言時請保持靜音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有兩個人用喇叭開外放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, Marco can share his screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We only see a gray box.
dialogue.zh: 我們只看到一個灰色視窗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me stop and restart it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick a window, not the desktop.
dialogue.zh: 選視窗，不要選整個桌面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在他的投影片顯示出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crisp and full size this time.
dialogue.zh: 這次又清楚又是全螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It froze on the big file.
dialogue.zh: 開大檔案的時候卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大檔案會讓他的筆電卡死。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you drop it in the chat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju drɑp ɪt ɪn ðə tʃæt?/
dialogue.zh: 你能把檔案傳到聊天室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, opening my own copy.
dialogue.zh: 收到了，我打開自己的副本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一樣的簡報，但檔案小很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 柏林那邊的影像不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把備用撥入號碼傳給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we hear him, no picture.
dialogue.zh: 現在聽得到他，但沒畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這裡只要有聲音就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He says a reboot fixed it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 他現在用手機重新加入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happens to all of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the host kept us going.
dialogue.zh: 好在主持人撐住了全場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 共享的畫面卡得很嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把那個多開的網頁分頁關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 大家都看得到第四頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We see it, but it's small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那就開靜音用打字溝通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I'll use the chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有人反對，錄下來沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, we can start now.
dialogue.zh: 都備齊了，我們現在開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們的測試版驗收完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do those bugs block the launch?
dialogue.zh: 那些問題會擋住上架嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不會，我們還是能照常上架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down before moving on.
dialogue.zh: 往下走之前先記錄下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 但這些資料看起來過時了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這報告到底是誰負責的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那比我們規劃多了一萬五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可能進到你的垃圾郵件了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 到時整個團隊一起決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好決定，進到供應商項目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We lean toward the cheaper one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那我們雙方是真的有意見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put both sides in the notes.
dialogue.zh: 把兩邊立場都寫進記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 寫好了，連發言人也標了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll bring it to the director.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, if testing passes this week.
dialogue.zh: 只要這週測試過關就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then lock it as the target.
dialogue.zh: 那就把它定為正式目標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每個任務都要指派負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 請用郵件回覆你們的日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在有什麼障礙要提嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the wait won't hurt us.
dialogue.zh: 那等待時間就不會拖累我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 新聞稿這一項就算定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I do, about the hiring plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們還需要兩位工程師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Budget says no, legal says yes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy the client on the notes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只發能給客戶看的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The data flow needs an owner.
dialogue.zh: 資料流程需要一個負責人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們今天只開了四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們還在一個小時之內。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 散會前還有什麼要說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Make it quick, Berlin is tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Berlin, what time is it there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們這邊快晚上九點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And Austin is back from lunch.
dialogue.zh: 奧斯汀那邊才剛吃飽回到座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tom had his coffee at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 各負責人都確認過日期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 陰冷的柏林跟大家再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 大家的畫面一個個消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 下午大家都想清靜一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna, can I keep you a moment?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈænə, kæn aɪ kip ju ə ˈmoʊmənt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather ask one on one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, the rest can go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 第六頁那個數字讓我困惑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那個是淨成本，不是總額。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll add a note for everyone.
dialogue.zh: 我會幫所有人加上註解。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 剛剛那場單獨討論很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easier than in the full room.
dialogue.zh: 比全會議室一起討論容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ring you about the vendor.
dialogue.zh: 供應商的事我再打給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會議記錄一下就要寄來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you add the action list?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把連結放在郵件裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll remove the red marks first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 會後補一封郵件很聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent it, did you get it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's track the action items.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them on the project board.
dialogue.zh: 把它們放到專案看板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Klaus is on the support draft.
dialogue.zh: 克勞斯在趕那份客服初稿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If a date slips, say so.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這是我們團隊的新規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 合理，大家都會忘記事情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did legal answer about the draft?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可以掛我的名增加急迫性。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the board up to date?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next call is in two weeks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大家就不用重新排時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對我們來講提早三十分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那會正好撞到奧斯汀的午休。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too cruel, keep it as is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們輪流承擔尷尬時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll note that in the log.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 以後開會我們會感謝這個決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會開得真好，不久後再聊，拜。
